items.title: Braelon Allen: Handling lead role again Sunday
items.text:
Allen will remain the Jets' No. 1 back for Sunday's Week 7 matchup against the Dolphins, as Breece Hall has been declared inactive for the contest.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: May not get full workload Sunday
items.text:
Jacobs is expected to start in his season debut Sunday against the Lions, but the extent of his role is likely to be decided upon as the game unfolds, according to Jay Glazer of Fox Sports.
